name: Aion Dashboard for WooCommerce
author: aionmedia

sections.description:
Standard WooCommerce analytics can drastically slow down your store’s backend and are often overloaded with irrelevant data. Aion Dashboard for WooCommerce is a free, custom tool created by the engineers at Aion Media. We designed it for store owners who need hard data to scale their sales, without compromising performance.

The plugin operates entirely on the backend and does not affect the page load time for your customers.

Key features:

  • Instant overview: Gross revenue and order count for the selected month.
  • Average Order Value (AOV): The crucial metric for evaluating your Ads campaigns profitability.
  • Period comparisons: Automatic calculation of growth and decline (Month-over-Month / Year-over-Year).
  • Most profitable customers: LTV summary with direct links to customer profiles.
  • Bestsellers: Top 5 best-selling products.
  • Discount codes: Value of discounts given and most popular coupons.

Need deeper store optimization?

Aion Dashboard for WooCommerce is just the foundation. If your e-commerce is loading slowly, you are losing margin on abandoned carts, or you want to implement advanced data-driven Meta/Google Ads campaigns – check out the offer from the creators of this plugin.
Build a bulletproof store with Aion Media.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the aion-dashboard-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory on your server, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress dashboard (Plugins -> Add New).
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Navigate to the new “Aion Dashboard” tab in the main WordPress sidebar to get instant insights into your statistics.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin slow down the frontend?

No. Aion Dashboard for WooCommerce does not load any CSS or JS scripts on the client side. All calculations and views are rendered exclusively for the administrator in the store’s backend.

Do I need to configure additional settings?

No. The plugin is Plug&Play. Immediately after installation, it analyzes your WooCommerce order database and displays the ready dashboard.
